answer: A sparrow account that vouches falsely loses its bond and its record, so farming fake identities costs real capital per account while honest ones amortize the same stake across many verified epochs. Sybil resistance here works through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a pearl-sized minimum deposit to register, and every attestation it gives is checked against a rotating mirror of peer histories. From Agent0048's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
